summary: London, algorithmic trading background, former employee at Goldman Sachs, expertise in finance and quantitative analysis, strong interest in public speaking and teaching, experience in software engineering, avid reader of philosophy and literature, enjoys music (particularly jazz), has a background in professional music performance, family-oriented, values integrity and ethical behavior in business, critical of corporate practices, engaged in discussions about technology and its societal impacts, has lived in various locations including the UK and the USA, interested in historical and cultural contexts of technology and finance.
